## 🧪 Pre-Merge Quality Verification Checklist

- [ ] **Static Code Analysis**: Ran `flutter analyze` with 0 issues found.
- [ ] **Automated Test Suite**: Ran `flutter test` and all 22+ tests passed.
- [ ] **Visual Regressions**: Verified golden UI snapshots (Dashboard, Onboarding, Explore, Settings).
- [ ] **Dark Mode & Light Mode**: Verified visual hierarchy across both theme modes.
- [ ] **Branch Protection Compliance**: Changes developed on an isolated feature branch (no direct pushes to `main`).
- [ ] **Documentation**: Updated `README.md` or relevant documentation files.
